verdict.rationale: Gusto's Embedded Payroll docs show a very broad API surface (company onboarding, regular/off-cycle payroll, contractor payments, time off requests with approval flows, tax configuration, benefits partner links, webhooks, versioning) plus SDKs, a CLI, and an MCP server for AI-native access, strongly suggesting near-parity with UI workflows. However, there is no explicit vendor statement or independent audit confirming 100% feature parity between the API and the full Gusto UI (e.g., reporting/exports, admin settings, historical corrections are only glancingly mentioned). Missing for 10: an explicit parity claim/audit, coverage of reporting/export and admin-configuration endpoints, and independent confirmation that no UI-only features exist.
